items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Charles Edward Smith at that time in our period in New York was getting some acclaim as a writer.

ctx.x: But the musicians have gotten closer, if anything. Oh, there are certain ones that we don't want to be around, when you start talking, because -- let's get together. Well, I've got to tell you this story about critics, because you would appreciate it and it's part of the history.
Charles Edward Smith at that time in our period in New York was getting some acclaim as a writer.
He was writing for Esquire; as was Leonard.
